cli.help:
MIDI Head Align

Usage:
  (no arguments)                    launch the GUI
  [file.mid]                        launch the GUI with that file
  --detect <in.mid>                 print detected BPM and beat offset
  --export <in> <out> --bpm <f>     export at the given BPM
       [--offset-ms <f>] [--bar-phase <0-3>] [--keep-ticks] [--lang <code|file>]

Language: ja / en / zh or a path to a language file (.json)
